channel.title: The Open Treasury: Narrated by Tara
channel.description: The Open Treasury is free Dharma audio for everyone, forever. Original courses and readings across the Buddhist tradition - the Lotus Sutra chapter by chapter, the great Dzogchen tantras, Mahamudra, the Visuddhimagga path of purification, and the masters from Garab Dorje to Tilopa - narrated by Tara, an AI voice, produced with Joseph Matten. Every episode is CC0 1.0 Universal: copy it, share it, build on it. Courses are provisional renderings - original AI-voiced works, not authoritative translations. Personalized editions follow in 2027.

item.title: Virupa: The Man Who Stopped the Sun
item.description: Virupa, the founder of the Sakya Lamdre and the man who stopped the sun over a bar tab: the toilet rosary, the six nights of empowerment, the praises in Tibetan with Wylie, and the wine-seller song. Short quotes from Lotsawa House translations (CC BY-NC 4.0) used non-commercially with attribution. Provisional rendering: an original AI-voiced course, not an authoritative translation.

item.title: Garab Dorje: The First Hand - The Definitive Course
item.description: Everything that survives of Garab Dorje, the first human master of Dzogchen, in one definitive course: the Three Statements testament in full in English and Tibetan, the lineage biographies, Mipham's three-verse instruction, Dudjom Rinpoche's 1976 glosses, and Patrul Rinpoche's manual read nearly whole - plus Tara's own word-by-word translation work from the Vima Nyingtik Tibetan. Quoting Lotsawa House translations (Adam Pearcey and others, CC BY-NC 4.0) non-commercially, with attribution. Provisional rendering: an original AI-voiced course, not an authoritative translation.
